content.what_it_is: EFDC+ 12.4의 최상위 PROGRAM EFDC와 오류 종료 루틴 STOPP를 한 파일에 둔 실행 오케스트레이터다. 프로그램 선언과 물리·수송 범위는 L36-L78, 모듈 결합은 L126-L161, 지역 작업변수 선언은 L166-L251에 있다. 실행부는 버전/병렬 런타임 초기화(L253-L402), 입력과 시간·출력 스케줄 구축(L405-L800), 격자 좌표·곡률·경계·퇴적층 edge 구축(L809-L1260), sigma-z 층과 면 metric 구축(L1267-L2924), 염분·수온·dye·SFL·toxic·cohesive/noncohesive sediment 초기장 및 경계값 초기화(L1649-L2297), WQ·shellfish·propwash·EFDC Explorer와 HDMT/HDMT2T 실행 분기(L3069-L3198), 종료 통계·시간 파일·MPI reduction/finalize(L3204-L3555), STOPP 구현(L3559-L3605)을 순서대로 수행한다. LXLY 좌표는 임시 global row를 읽어 local/global map에 복제하며(L841-L856), 선택적으로 WGS84→UTM 변환한다(L858-L865). SGZ는 입력/기본 DZC를 정규화하고(L1267-L1399), active layer mask·face thickness·vertical derivative coefficient를 만든다(L1417-L2850).

unresolved: L853-L865: LXLY record is copied from R2D_Global(1,:) into R2D_Global(LG,:) before the ISWGS84 branch converts only row 1. Consequently Center_X/Center_Y use converted UTM values while later DLON/DLAT mapping from row LG uses the pre-conversion coordinates; verify whether the copy was intended after conversion.

L924-L929: DETTMP is first assigned the reciprocal determinant and then compared with 0.0. A singular denominator raises division-by-zero/Inf rather than making its reciprocal exactly zero, so the STOPP singular-transform guard is ineffective.

L1031-L1033: foodchain matrix input reads the leading formatted integer into real C, but the diagnostic WRITE emits JDUMY, which is declared but is not assigned in this branch; the echoed row label is undefined/stale.

L1322-L1326: immediately before the IGRIDV==0 block, DO K=1,KC has completed. The block assigns DZC_Global(LG,:)=DZCK(K) instead of a vector/subscripted K loop, so K is the post-loop value (normally KC+1) and can be out of bounds while broadcasting one scalar across all layers.

L1341-L1358: IGRIDV==1 reads only IIN,JIN,K, leaving R1D_Global at its zero initialization; the code still normalizes and stores an all-zero DZC_Global row. Local DZC is later rebuilt from DZCK for IGRIDV==1, but SGZLAYER.OUT/global reporting can retain the zero row; intended reporting semantics are unclear.

L1968-L1991: the south toxic boundary initialization tests NCSERS(LL,4), whereas west/east/north tests use toxic constituent index 5. This direction-only 4-versus-5 discrepancy is a likely copied suspended-load condition and can change whether south TOX values are imposed.
L2446-L2453: the SGZV normalization failure branch labels BAD SGZV and tests SUM(SGZV), but its per-layer diagnostic prints SGZU rather than SGZV, obscuring the failing field.

L1567-L1595: the single-domain comparison branch reads domain_list_*.txt without OUTDIR, whereas the multi-domain producer branch writes OUTDIR//mpi_list. Unless the working directory is OUTDIR, the files produced by one branch are not found by the other.

L2967-L2978: MAPHMD.INP supplies L,I,J but the code uses L directly as a local array index without LIJ(I,J) or Map2Local conversion. In decomposed MPI domains a global L may select the wrong local cell or exceed the local allocation.

L927/L1366/L1371 versus L3559-L3572: multiple calls pass STOPP('.',1), while the GNU preprocessor branch defines only STOPP(MSG). With no explicit interface this may rely on ABI tolerance for an extra actual argument; it is an interface mismatch even though the non-GNU IOPEN argument is optional.

L3322-L3399 versus L3404-L3424: text timing reports include TPROPW and display DSITIMING slices of 13 or 16 entries, but TIME.CSV omits TPROPW and maps only selected DSITIME entries; consumers cannot assume identical timing columns across outputs.
